nb2_lite.texto: A folded 1966 Australian newspaper reporting the mine closure. The newspaper lies open on a kitchen table, a fine film of blue-grey dust settling across its front page. A Wittenoom company house kitchen, asbestos-cement walls, laminex table, linoleum floor, 1966. Hard high-contrast side light from a small window. Detail shot, high angle looking down on the table, macro detail, shallow depth of field. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1966, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio.
